task.title: Decide whether read-path scenarios carry duration targets
task.description:
The 2026-07-30 scaling work added a cold 'cli-list' read scenario to the benchmark registry. It deliberately carries no duration target, because the approved 200 ms cold budget was set for single mutations and no budget has been approved for read paths. It therefore reports 'not-evaluated' in whole-harness runs.

Adding cli-list to the registry also changed the default scenario set: runs that omit --scenario now include it.

Measured cold cli-list medians at commit 725a2838 are 59.44 ms at 100 active tasks, 68.83 ms at 500, and 84.84 ms at 1000, growing 1.43x for a 10x task-count increase and staying flat across the history-depth axis.

Decide whether cold read paths get an executable duration target, and if so at what value and on what statistic, or record that they remain descriptive by design. Do not invent a threshold without an approved budget.

Acceptance: the decision is documented in docs/performance/README.md, and either cli-list carries an approved target classified automatically in generated reports, or the README states that read scenarios are descriptive and explains why.
